unn emaan walon ney yaqeenan falah paali hai .
jo apni namaz mein dil say jhukney walay hain ,
aur jo laghw cheezon say mun morray huye hain .
aur jo zakat per amal kernay walay hain ,
aur jo apni sharmgahon ki ( aur sabb say ) hifazat kertay hain ,
siwaye apni biwiyon aur unn kaneezon kay jo unn ki milkiyat mein aa-chuki hon ,   kiyonkay aesay log qabil-e-malamat nahi hain ,
haan jo iss kay ilawa koi aur tareeqa ikhtiyar kerna chahen to aesay log hadd say guzray huye hain .
aur woh jo apni amanton aur apney ehad ka paas rakhney walay hain ,
aur jo apni namazon ki poori nigrani rakhtay hain .
yeh hain woh waris .
jinhen jannat-ul-Firdous ki meeras milay gi .   yeh uss mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .
aur hum ney insan ko mitti kay satt say peda kiya ,
phir hum ney ussay tapki hoi boond ki shakal mein aik mehfooz jagah per rakha ,

phir hum ney uss boond ko jamay huye khoon ki shakal dey di , phir uss jamay huye khoon ko aik loathra bana diya , phir uss loathray ko haddiyon mein tabdeel kerdiya , phir haddiyon ko gosht ka libas pehnaya , phir ussay aesi uthaan di kay woh aik doosri hi makhlooq ban ker kharra hogaya . gharz bari shaan hai Allah ki jo saray karigaron say barh ker karigar hai !
phir iss sabb kay baad tumhen yaqeenan moat aaney wali hai ,
phir qayamat kay din tumhen yaqeenan dobara zinda kiya jaye ga .
aur hum ney tumharay oopper saat teh bar teh raastay peda kiye hain , aur hum makhlooq say ghafil nahi hain .
aur hum ney aasman say theek andazay kay mutabiq paani utaara , phir ussay zameen mein thehra diya ,   aur yaqeen rakho , hum ussay ghaeeb ker-denay per bhi qadir hain .
phir hum ney uss say tumharay liye khujooron aur angooron kay baaghaat peda kiye jinn say tumhen boht say meway hasil hotay hain , aur unhi mein say tum khatay ho .
aur woh darkht bhi peda kiya jo toor-e-seena say nikalta hai ,   jo apney sath tel ley ker aur khaney walon kay liye salan ley ker ugta hai .

aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay liye maweshiyon mein bari naseehat ka saman hai . jo ( doodh ) unn kay pet mein hai , uss say hum tumhen sairaab kertay hain , aur unn mein tumharay liye boht say fawaeed hain , aur unhi say tum ghiza bhi hasil kertay ho .
aur unhi per aur kashtiyon per tumhen sawar bhi kiya jata hai .

aur hum ney nooh ko unn ki qoam kay paas bheja tha , chunacheh unhon ney ( qoam say ) kaha kay :  meri qoam kay logo ! Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . bhala kiya tum dartay nahi ho-?

iss per unn ki qoam kay kafir sardaron ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki iss kay siwa koi haqeeqat nahi kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai jo tum per apni bartari jamana chahta hai , aur agar Allah chahta to farishtay nazil ker deta . yeh baat to hum ney apney pichlay baap dadon mein kabhi nahi suni .
. ( raha yeh shaks , to ) yeh aur kuch nahi , aik aisa aadmi hai jissay junoon laahaq hogaya hai , iss liye kuch waqt tak iss ka intizar ker kay dekh lo ( kay shayad apney hawaas mein aajaye )
nooh ney kaha :  ya rab ! inn logon  ney mujhay jiss tarah jhoota banaya hai , uss per to hi meri madad farma .

chunacheh hum ney unn kay paas wahi bheji kay :  tum humari nigrani mein aur humari wahi kay mutabiq kashti banao . phir jab humara hukum aajaye , aur tanoor ubal parray ,   to her qisam kay janweron mein say aik aik jorra ley ker ussay bhi uss kashti mein sawar ker lena ,   aur apney ghar walon ko bhi , siwaye unn kay jinn kay khilaf pehlay hi hukum sadir hochuka hai .   aur inn zalimon kay baaray mein mujh say koi baat naa kerna , yeh baat tey hai kay yeh sabb gharq kiye jayen gay .
phir jab tum aur tumharay sathi kashti mein theek theek beth chuken , to kehna :  shukar hai Allah ka jiss ney hamen zalim logon  say nijat ata farmaee .
aur kehna :  ya-Rab ! mujhay aisa utarna naseeb ker jo barkat wala ho , aur tu behtareen utaarney wala hai .
iss saray waqaey mein bari nishaniyan hain , aur yaqeeni baat hai kay hamen aazmaesh to kerni hi kerni thi .
phir unn kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken ,
aur unn kay darmiyan unhi mein kay aik shaks ko Rasool bana ker bheja .   ( jiss ney kaha ) kay :  Allah ki ibadat kero , uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi hai . bhala kiya tum dartay nahi ho-?

unn ki qoam kay woh sardar jinhon ney kufr apna rakha tha , aur jinhon ney aakhirat ka samna kernay ko jhutlaya tha , aur jinn ko hum ney dunyawi zindagi mein khoob aesh dey rakha tha , unhon ney ( aik doosray say ) kaha :  iss shaks ki haqeeqat iss kay siwa kuch nahi hai kay yeh tumhi jaisa aik insan hai . jo cheez tum khatay ho , yeh bhi khata hai , aur jo tum peetay ho , yeh bhi peeta hai .
aur agar kahen tum ney apney hi jaisay aik insan ki farmanbardaari qubool kerli to tum baray hi ghatay ka soda kero gay .
bhala batao yeh shaks tumhen darata hai kay jab tum mar-jao gay , aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojao gay , to tumhen dobara zameen say nikala jaye ga-?
jiss baat say tumhen daraya jaraha hai , woh to boht hi baeed baat hai , samajh say bilkul hi door !
zindagi to humari iss dunyawi zindagi kay siwa koi aur nahi hai , ( yahin ) hum martay aur jeetay hain , aur hamen dobara zinda nahi kiya jasakta .
. ( raha yeh shaks , to ) yeh aur kuch nahi , aik aisa aadmi hai jiss ney Allah per jhoota bohtan gharra hai , aur hum iss per emaan laney walay nahi hain .
payghumber ney kaha :  ya rab ! inn logon  ney mujhay jiss tarah jhoota banaya hai , uss per tu hi meri madad farma .
Allah ney farmaya :  abb thori hi dair ki baat hai kay yeh log pachtatay reh jayen gay .
chunacheh iss sachay waday kay mutabiq unn ko aik chinghaarr ney aa-pakra aur hum ney unhen koorra karkat bana ker rakh diya . phitkaar hai aesay zalim logon  per !
iss kay baad hum ney doosri naslen peda ken .
koi ummat naa apney moyyan waqt say pehlay jasakti hai , naa uss kay baad thehar sakti hai .

phir hum ney pey-dar-pay apney payghumber bhejay , jab bhi kissi qoam kay paas uss ka payghumber aata to woh ussay jhutlatay , chunacheh hum ney bhi aik kay baad aik ( ko halak kernay ) ka silsila baandh diya , aur unhen qissa kahaniyan bana daala . phitkaar hai unn logon  per jo emaan nahi latay !
phir hum ney musa aur unn kay bhai Haroon ko apni nishaniyon aur wazeh saboot kay sath
firon aur uss kay sardaron kay paas bheja to unhon ney ghamand ka muzahira kiya , aur woh baray takabbur walay log thay .
chunacheh kehney lagay :  kiya hum apney jaisay do aadmiyon per emaan ley ayen , halankay unn ki qoam humari ghulami ker rahi hai ?
iss tarah unhon ney unn dono ko jhutlaya , aur aakhir kaar woh bhi unn logon  say jaa milay jinhen halak kiya gaya tha .
aur musa ko hum ney kitab ata farmaee , takay unn kay log rehnumai hasil keren .

aur maryam kay betay ( essa aleh-assalam ) ko aur unn ki maa ko hum ney aik nishani banaya , aur unn dono ko aik aesi bulandi per panah di jo aik pursukoon jagah thi , aur jahan saaf suthra paani behta tha .
aey payghumbero ! pakeezah cheezon mein say ( jo chahao ) khao aur naik amal kero . yaqeen rakho kay jo kuch tum kertay ho , mujhay uss ka poora poora ilm hai .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay yehi tumhara deen hai , ( sabb kay liye ) aik hi deen ! aur mein tumhara perwerdigar hun , iss liye dil mein ( sirf ) mera roab rakho .
phir huwa yeh kay logon  ney apney deen mein baham phoot daal ker firqay bana liye . her giroh ney apney khayal mein jo tareeqa ikhtiyar kerliya hai , ussi per magan hai .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) inn ko aik khaas waqt tak apni jihalat mein dooba rehney do .
kiya yeh log iss khayal mein hain kay hum inn ko jo dolat aur aulad diye jarahey hain ,
to unn ko bhalaiyan phonchaney mein jaldi dikha rahey hain-?   nahi , balkay inn ko haqeeqat ka shaoor nahi hai .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log apney perwerdigar kay roab say daray rehtay hain ,
aur jo apney perwerdigar ki aayaton per emaan latay hain ,
aur jo apney perwerdigar kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi mantay ,
aur woh jo amal bhi kertay hain , ussay kertay waqt unn kay dil iss baat say sehmay hotay hain kay unhen apney perwerdigar kay paas wapis jana hai ,
woh hain jo bhalaiyan hasil kernay mein jaldi dikha rahey hain , aur woh hain jo unn ki taraf tezi say aagay barh rahey hain .
aur hum kissi shaks ko uss ki taqat say ziyada kissi kaam ki zimma daari nahi detay , aur humaray paas aik kitab hai jo ( sabb ka haal ) theek theek bol dey gi , aur unn per koi zulm nahi hoga .
lekin unn kay dil iss baat say ghaflat mein doobay huye hain , aur iss kay ilawa unn ki aur bhi kaarastaniyan hain jo woh kertay rehtay hain .
yahan tak kay jab hum unn kay dolat mand logon  ko azab mein pakar len gay to woh aik dum bilbila uthen gay .
aaj bilbilao nahi , humari taraf say tumhen koi madad nahi milay gi .
meri aayaten tum ko parh ker sunai jati then , to tum ultay paon murr jatay thay ,
baray ghuroor say iss ( Quran ) kay baaray mein raat ko majlisen jama ker beyhooda baaten kertay thay .
bhala kiya inn logon  ney iss kalam per ghor nahi kiya , ya inn kay paas koi aesi cheez aagae hai jo inn kay pichlay baap dadon kay paas nahi aai thi ?
ya yeh apney payghumber ko ( pehlay say ) jantay hi nahi thay , iss wajeh say unn ka inkar ker rahey hain-?

ya unn ka kehna hai kay inn ( payghumber ) ko junoon laahaq hogaya hai ? nahi , balkay ( asal wajeh yeh hai kay ) yeh payghumber inn kay paas haq ley ker aaye hain , aur inn mein say aksar log haq ko pasand nahi kertay .

aur agar haq inn ki khuwaishaat kay tabey hojata to aasman aur zameen aur unn mein basney walay sabb barbad hojatay . nahi , balkay hum unn kay paas khud unn kay liye naseehat ka saman ley ker aaye hain , aur woh hain kay khud apni naseehat say mun morray huye hain .

ya ( inn kay inkar ki wajeh yeh hai kay ) tum inn say koi moawza maang rahey ho-? to ( yeh baat bhi ghalat hai , iss liye kay ) tumharay perwerdigar ka diya huwa moawza ( tumharay liye ) kahen behtar hai , aur woh behtareen rizq denay wala hai .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay tum to unhen seedhay raastay ki taraf bula rahey ho ,
aur jo log aakhirat per emaan nahi rakhtay , woh raastay say bilkul hatay huye hain .
aur agar hum inn per reham keren aur uss takleef ko door kerden jiss mein yeh mubtala hain tab bhi yeh bhataktay huye apni sarkashi per array rahen gay .
waqiaa yeh hai kay hum ney inn ko ( aik martaba ) azab mein pakra tha , to uss waqt bhi yeh log apney perwerdigar kay samney nahi jhukay . aur yeh to aajzi ki rawish ikhtiyar kertay hi nahi hain .
yahan tak kay jab hum inn per sakht azab wala darwaza khol den gay , to yeh aik dum uss mein mayyus ho ker reh jayen gay .
woh Allah hi to hai jiss ney tumharay liye kaan aur aankhen aur dil peda kiye . ( magar ) tum log boht kam shukar ada kertay ho .
aur wohi hai jiss ney tumhen zameen mein phelaya , aur ussi ki taraf tumhen ikattha ker kay ley jaya jaye ga .
aur wohi hai jo zindagi aur moat deta hai , aur ussi kay qabazay mein raat aur din ki tabeedilyan hain . kiya phir bhi tum aqal say kaam nahi letay-?
iss kay bajaye yeh log bhi wesi hi baaten kertay hain jaisi pichlay logon  ney ki then .
kehtay hain kay :  kiya jab hum mar-jayen gay aur mitti aur haddiyon mein tabdeel hojayen gay , to kiya waqaee hamen dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye ga-?

yeh woh yaqeen dahani hai jo hum say bhi ki gaee hai , aur iss say pehlay humaray baap dadon say bhi ki gaee thi . iss ki koi haqeeqat iss kay siwa nahi kay yeh pichlay logon  kay banaye huye afsaney hain .
. ( aey payghumber ! zara inn say ) kaho kay :  yeh sari zameen aur iss mein basney walay kiss ki milkiyat hain-? batao agar jantay ho .
woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .    kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum sabaq nahi letay-?
kaho kay :  saat aasmano ka malik aur aali shaan arsh ka malik kon hai ?
woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  yeh sabb kuch Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  kiya phir bhi tum Allah say nahi dartay-?
kaho kay :  kon hai jiss kay haath mein her cheez ka mukammal ikhtiyar hai , aur jo panah deta hai , aur uss kay muqablay mein koi kissi ko panah nahi dey sakta-? batao agar jantay ho .
woh zaroor yehi kahen gay kay :  sara ikhtiyar Allah ka hai .  kaho kay :  phir kahan say tum per koi jadoo chal jata hai ?
nahi ( yeh afsaney nahi ) balkay hum ney unhen haq baat phonchai hai , aur yeh log yaqeenan jhootay hain .

naa to Allah ney koi beta banaya hai , aur naa uss kay sath koi aur khuda hai . agar aisa hota to her khuda apni makhlooq ko ley ker alag hojata , aur phir woh aik doosray per charrhai ker-detay .   pak hai Allah unn baaton say jo yeh log banatay hain ,
woh Allah jissay tamam chupi aur khuli baaton ka mukammal ilm hai . lehaza woh inn kay shirk say boht buland o baala hai .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! jiss azab ki dhamki inn ( kafiron ) ko di jarahi hai , agar aap ussay meri aankhon kay samney ley ayen ,
to aey meray perwerdigar ! mujhay inn zalim logon  kay sath shamil naa kijiye ga .
aur yaqeen jano kay hum jiss cheez ki enhen dhamki dey rahey hain , ussay tumhari aankhon kay samney laney per poori tarah qadir hain .
. ( lekin jab tak woh waqt naa aaye ) tum burai ka dafiya aesay tareeqay say kertay raho jo behtareen ho .   jo baaten yeh log banatay hain , hum khoob jantay hain .
aur dua kero kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mein shetan kay lagaye huye charkon say aap ki panah maangta hun ,
aur meray perwerdigar ! mein unn kay apney qareeb aaney say bhi aap ki panah maangta hun .
yahan tak kay jab unn mein say kissi per moat aa-khari hogi to woh kahey ga kay :  meray perwerdigar ! mujhay wapis bhej dijiye ,

takay jiss duniya ko mein chorr aaya hun , uss mein jaker naik amal kerun .  hergiz nahi ! yeh to aik baat hi baat hai jo woh zaban say keh raha hai , aur inn ( marney walon ) kay samney aalam e barzakh ki aarr hai .   jo uss waqt tak qaeem rahey gi jab tak unn ko dobara zinda ker kay uthaya jaye .
phir jab soor phoonka jaye ga to uss din naa unn kay darmiyan rishtay natay baqi rahen gay , aur naa koi kissi ko poochay ga .
uss waqt jinn kay palray bhari niklay , to wohi hon gay jo falah payen gay ,
aur jinn kay palray halkay parr-gaye , to yeh woh log hon gay jinhon ney apney liye ghatay ka soda kiya tha , woh dozakh mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay .
aag unn kay chehron ko jhulas daalay gi , aur uss mein unn ki soorten bigar jayen gi .
. ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  kiya meri aayaten tumhen parh ker sunai nahi jati then-? aur tum unn ko jhutlaya kertay thay .
woh kahen gay :  humaray perwerdigar ! hum per humari bad-bakhti chah gaee thi , aur hum gumrah log thay .
humaray perwerdigar ! hamen yahan say bahir nikal dijiye , phir agar hum dobara wohi kaam keren to beyshak hum zalim hon gay .
Allah farmaye ga :  issi ( dozakh ) mein zaleel ho ker parray raho , aur mujh say baat bhi naa kero .

meray bandon mein say aik jamat yeh dua kerti thi kay : aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum emaan ley aaye hain , pus hamen bakhsh dijiye , aur hum per reham farmaiye , aur aap sabb reham kernay walon say barh ker reham farmaney walay hain .
to tum ney unn logon  ka mazaq banaya tha . yahan tak kay unn hi ( kay sath cher-chaar ) ney tumhen meri yaad tak say ghafil kerdiya , aur tum unn ki hansi uratay rahey .
unhon ney jiss tarah sabar say kaam liya tha , aaj mein ney unhen uss ka yeh badla diya hai kay unhon ney apni murad paali hai .
. ( phir ) Allah ( inn dozakhiyon say ) farmaye ga :  tum zameen mein ginti kay kitney saal rahey-?
woh kahen gay kay :  hum aik din ya aik din say bhi kam rahey hon gay .   ( hamen poori tarah yaad nahi ) iss liye jinhon ney ( waqt ki ) ginti ki ho , unn say pooch lijiye .
Allah farmaye ga :  tum thori mauddat say ziyada nahi rahey . kiya khoob hota agar yeh baat tum ney ( uss waqt ) samajh li hoti !
bhala kiya tum yeh samjhay bethay thay kay hum ney tumhen yunhi bey maqsad peda kerdiya ,   aur tumhen wapis humaray paas nahi laya jaye ga-?
gharz boht oonchi shaan hai Allah ki jo sahih maani mein badshah hai ! uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi , woh izzat walay arsh ka malik hai .

aur jo shaks Allah kay sath kissi aur khuda ko pukaray , jiss per uss kay paas kissi qisam ki koi daleel nahi , to uss ka hisab uss kay perwerdigar kay paas hai . yaqeen jano kay kafir log falah nahi paaskatay .
aur tum ( aey payghumber ) yeh kaho kay :  meray perwerdigar ! humari khatayen bakhsh dey , aur reham farmadey , tu saray reham kernay walon say barh ker reham kernay wala hai .
